# Tokenization request validation (v0.3, draft)
Owner: Dana Whitfield

Validator sits in front of POST /v1/tokenize. Bad requests get a 422 with the full error list, not just a bool. Support needs the reasons.

## PAN
- card.number must pass Luhn. 13-19 digits after stripping spaces and dashes.
- Never echo the full PAN in errors. Last 4 only.

## Expiry
- card.exp_month is 1-12, card.exp_year is 4 digits.
- Expired cards get rejected. Current month is still fine (Priya agreed).
- Anything more than 15 years out? not sure, we'll figure it out.

## CVV
- Raw CVV can be in the request for auth, but it must never make it into a stored payload. If card.cvv shows up in anything we persist, reject.

## Structure
- Max nesting depth is 8. Deeper = reject.
- Unicode: normalize to NFC before checks.
- null, missing, and "" are all treated as missing for required fields.

## Custom rules
- card.billing.address: country required. postal code format depends on country (US, CA, UK at minimum).
- metadata: flat object, string values only, max 50 keys.
- token_policy: one of single_use, multi_use, expiring. expiring needs ttl_seconds.

## Open question
- Should we check BIN ranges against the issuer list here, or is that a separate service? Not decided. Ping me before you build anything on it.
